fact: The Maseno Centre for Applied AI, with the ACTS-AI4D team, did a pre-visit to Suba ahead of the main exercise collecting Dholuo speech data with the SmartVoice application to improve Dholuo representation in AI.
The GSMA and the governments of Benin, Kenya, Namibia, Nigeria and Togo launched ATLAS Umoja AI to build AI models for African languages, with private partners Awarri, Zindi, Pawa AI and Mozisha.
Vodacom group CTO Dejan Kastelic told Business Day that Kenya will be the second node where Vodacom plans to build GPUs as a service.

Atlancis Technologies (Servernah Cloud) announces it has delivered and deployed a GPU-powered AI factory, built on OCP design principles with NVIDIA GPUs and offered as a cloud service, hosted at iXAfrica's NBOX1 campus in Kenya.
Atlancis Technologies says the NVIDIA GPU-powered Servernah AI factory is delivered and deployed at iXAfrica's NBOX1 data centre in Kenya, making GPUs locally accessible.

Atlancis, EverseTech and iXAfrica launched Servernah Cloud, described as Kenya's first sovereign-hosted cloud and AI platform, with locally available GPU capacity for AI inference and model deployment, at iXAfrica's Nairobi facility.
iXAfrica's CEO Snehar Shah said the AI infrastructure deployment is 'now live for the market', and EverseTech demonstrated locally available GPU capacity at the 22.5 MW Nairobi data centre.
